column1: # Genuine upstream BusyBox ash (same pinned source/config as 16-case matrix).
# A child writes a ready file, then spins exclusively in user mode.
# The parent cannot run the kill and success marker until a real timer IRQ
# preempts the child; a cooperative scheduler times out (QEMU 15s budget).

column3: sh -c "(echo ready > /tmp/preempt-ready; while :; do :; done) & hog=$!; while [ ! -f /tmp/preempt-ready ]; do :; done; kill -9 $hog; echo cpu-hog-did-not-starve-ash"
